hypotheses.expect: On Windows the tester starts each proof in a job object that kills every descendant when the run ends, and with no console window, so a scratch process a proof starts dies with that proof and opens no window; the sites that spawn are not edited.
hypotheses.falsifier: (1) on nt the tester starts a proof with CREATE_NO_WINDOW inside a job that carries KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, and closing the job ends every descendant; (2) on posix run_owned is subprocess.run with the same arguments, and the proof run is unchanged; (3) device.py has no subprocess.run left at the proof-run and exec sites; both go through run_owned; (4) kill_what_it_started on nt no longer answers that environments cannot be enumerated
hypotheses.piece: D1: the fix at cairn/devices/tester/runs.py, cairn/devices/tester/device.py
